d:
Good Morning Dosto!
Iss video me hum lekar aaye hain Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor ke Package-06 ka ground report.
Yeh package HG Infra dwara construct kiya ja raha hai, jiska stretch hai Chainage KM 293.000 to KM 338.500, poora Koraput district, Odisha me aata hai.
Package-06 Highlights:
Starting section complete with lane marking & crash barriers
Major bridge under construction at 3.7 km
Viaduct over railway line (near completion)
Simliguda Interchange (Exit-15) & Pottangi Interchange (Exit-16)
